scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=apps/api & npm run dev --workspace=apps/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit --incremental false && node scripts/check-feature-contract.mjs
scripts.physics:build: cd packages/physics && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg && npm run physics:build:web
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path packages/physics/Cargo.toml && npm run typecheck
scripts.physics:build:web: cd packages/physics && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg-web && mkdir -p ../../apps/web/public/physics && cp pkg-web/rtz_physics.js pkg-web/rtz_physics_bg.wasm pkg-web/rtz_physics.d.ts ../../apps/web/public/physics/
